supersedes: cycle-2-stream-c-source-ledger-v1 only for the named Stream-C Route-B dependency assessment
claim_boundary: This ledger closes the four external analytic dependency nodes used by the exact Stream-C Route-B replay. It does not independently prove Guth--Maynard's truncated explicit formula, their short-interval argument, or a new theorem about primes.

correction.corrected_v1_statement: The v1 ledger called the Huxley alternative unread and left the near-one density node OBSERVED.
correction.cause: It overlooked the direct visual inspection and exact locator already recorded in docs/literature-ledger-classical-inputs.md.
correction.replacement: Huxley (1.9), printed p. 164 / PDF p. 173, was directly inspected: N(s,T) << T^[3(1-s)/(3s-1)](log T)^44, uniformly for 3/4 <= s <= 1, with ordinates -T <= gamma <= T. On 4/5 <= s <= 1 its exponent coefficient is at most 30/13.
correction.effect: The Jutila scan is no longer needed on the near-one branch; the v1 artifact is retained unchanged.

sources.role: Displayed truncated explicit formula and short-interval deductions being replayed

sources.locator: Theorem 1.2 and the exact case-split replay cycle-1-route-b-v3-theorem-1-2-case-split.json

sources.role: Two-sided, logarithmically uniform density bound on the near-one branch
sources.citation: M. N. Huxley, The distribution of zeros of the Riemann zeta-function, Invent. Math. 15 (1972), 141-163
sources.locator: equation (1.9), printed p. 164 / PDF p. 173; inspected visually
sources.checked_statement: N(s,T) << T^(3(1-s)/(3s-1)) (log T)^44 uniformly for 3/4 <= s <= 1, for ordinates -T <= gamma <= T.
sources.transfer: For 4/5 <= s <= 1, 3/(3s-1) <= 30/13; the exact (log T)^44 factor is retained.

sources.role: Zero-free region above the finite-height verification range
sources.citation: Kevin Ford, Zero-free regions for the Riemann zeta function (2002)

sources.role: Finite-height completion of the zero-free cutoff
sources.citation: D. Platt and T. Trudgian, The Riemann hypothesis is true up to 3*10^12, Bull. London Math. Soc. 53 (2021), 792-797
sources.checked_statement: All non-trivial zeros through height 3,000,175,332,800 have real part 1/2; the computation is rigorous interval arithmetic.

sources.role: Explicit Riemann-von Mangoldt estimate used to derive the unit-strip count
sources.citation: E. Hasanalizade, Q. Shen, and P.-J. Wong, Counting zeros of the Riemann zeta function, J. Number Theory 235 (2022), 219-241
sources.locator: Corollary 1.1 / (1.4), source lines 255-261; its argument-principle derivation at lines 327-334 and 940-949
sources.checked_statement: For T >= e, |N(T)-T/(2pi) log(T/(2pi e))| <= 0.1038 log T+0.2573 loglog T+9.3675.

sources.role: Pins that the Riemann-von Mangoldt zero count and zero sums use multiplicity
sources.citation: H. M. Bui and D. R. Heath-Brown, On simple zeros of the Riemann zeta-function, Bull. London Math. Soc. 45 (2013), 953-961
sources.checked_statement: N(T) counts zeros 0<gamma<T with each zero counted with multiplicity m(rho), explicitly distinguished from the distinct-zero count.

closed_dependency_nodes: multiplicity-inclusive unit-height zero count and reciprocal-distance sum
